name: cavemio-tree-view
title: Tree view
description: The sidebar of pages, folders or files: carry a row up, down and sideways to nest it, and folders open as you hold them.

cavemio.accessibility:
- A tree of treeitems with their level, position and open state. One row is in the tab order: ↑ ↓ move, → opens a row or steps into it, ← closes it or steps out to its parent, Home and End jump, typing a title's first letters jumps to it, Enter or Space chooses.
- Alt with ↑ or ↓ moves a row among its siblings, Alt+→ moves it into the row above, Alt+← moves it out after its parent. F2 renames and Delete deletes. Every move is announced with where it went.
- Carrying writes transforms only, to the copy, the line and the ring; rows are measured once when the carry starts (and again only when a row opens under it), and nothing re-renders until the drop. Rows are memoised, so opening a folder re-renders only the rows it changes.
- On touch the list scrolls as usual; holding a row for 300ms picks it up, and only then does the page stop scrolling. A chosen row shows its + and delete buttons, since there's no hover. Near the top or bottom of the tree (or the window) it scrolls.
- Reduced motion opens, closes and moves rows in place; the line, the ring, the amber refusal and the announcements still say what happens.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: nodes / defaultNodes
props.type: T extends { id, parent, title, leaf? }[]
props.description: – · Every node, flat; parent is null at the top level. Siblings stand in the order they appear. leaf rows can't hold others.

props.name: onNodesChange
props.description: – · The new list after every move, rename, add, delete and undo.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: – · A row chosen by click, Enter or Space, e.g. to open its page.

props.name: icon
props.description: – · The row's icon. Defaults to a folder (open or closed), or a file for leaves.

props.name: canDrop
props.description: – · A reason parent won't take node; null is the top level. Moving a row into itself or into a leaf is refused for you.

props.name: onMove
props.description: – · Saves a move (node already has its new parent). Throw to put it back.

props.name: onRename
props.description: – · Turns on renaming (F2, double-click). Throw to put the old title back.

props.name: onCreate
props.description: – · Turns on + (inside rows, and New … at the foot). Return the stored node.

props.name: onDelete
props.description: – · Turns on delete. Called once the chance to undo is over; throw to bring the row back.

props.name: undoFor
props.description: 5000 · How long Undo is offered after a delete, ms.

features.title: Folders open and close smoothly
features.description: Children slide out from under their row while the rows below make room, and closing folds them back.

features.title: Drag to a gap and a depth
features.description: Up and down picks the gap, sideways picks the depth, and the line starts exactly where the row will sit.

features.title: Drop inside a folder
features.description: Hold a row over the middle of another and it takes a ring. A closed folder opens itself after a moment.

features.title: Rules can refuse a place
features.description: canDrop returns a reason, the line turns amber and the reason shows under what you carry.

features.title: Rename, add and delete
features.description: F2 renames in place, + adds a row inside, and Delete removes it with an Undo before your function is called.

features.title: Keyboard and safe saving
features.description: Arrow keys navigate, Alt with the arrows moves a row, and a failed save takes the row back.

states.title: open
states.description: Opening a row turns its chevron (260ms) while its children fade in through a 4px blur where they land and the rows below glide down (480ms). Closing folds the children away where they stood while the rows below glide up. An open row with nothing inside says so.

states.title: lift
states.description: After 4px (or a 300ms hold on touch, with a short vibration where supported) a copy of the row lifts: a thin line ring and a "+3" count of what's inside it. The row and everything under it dim to 40% in place.

states.title: slot
states.description: The gap under the pointer gets a 2px line in the ring colour with a hollow dot at its start; the start is the depth the row will land at (90ms per change). Sideways movement changes the depth one indent at a time, inside the depths that gap allows.

states.title: into
states.description: Over the middle half of a row that holds others, a ring and a light wash surround it: the row will go inside, at the end. Held there 650ms, a closed row with rows inside opens; rows opened this way close again if nothing was dropped in them.

states.title: refuse
states.description: When canDrop returns a reason, the line or ring turns amber and the reason appears under the carried copy. Let go and the copy springs home (300ms, slight overshoot); the reason stays a moment under the tree.

states.title: land
states.description: The moved row glides from where the copy was let go into its slot (480ms), its parent opening if it was closed; rows that changed depth slide sideways into their new indent. If onMove throws, everything glides back, the row shakes, and the line under the tree says so.

states.title: edit
states.description: F2 or a double-click turns the title into a field in place. + on a row grows a new row inside it with a field; Enter keeps it, Escape folds it away. Delete folds the row and everything inside it away and holds "Deleted … · Undo" over a draining thin line (paused on hover) before calling onDelete.
